caseName: C. H. Albers Commission Co. v. Spencer
caseNameFull: C. H. Albers Commission Company, in Error v. Mary E. Spencer and Harlow B. Spencer, and of the Estate of Corwin H. Spencer
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri.
attorneys: Mr. Shepard Barclay for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Frederick N. Judson and Mr. John F. Green for the defendants in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Kansas City Star Company v. Julian, 215 U. S. 589, 590; Wood v. Chesborough, 228 U. S. 672.
